title: Adaptive Order Policies for Masked Diffusion
abstract: arXiv:2606.00295v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Masked diffusion models have seen great success in capturing data distributions over discrete sequences in domains such as text and proteins. These models generate data by iteratively unmasking tokens starting from a fully masked sequence, with the unmasking order typically chosen at random or using a heuristic based on denoiser probabilities. In this work, we propose a scheme for learning the unmasking order using an additional lightweight policy network on top of a diffusion model. Our proposed loss reweights terms in the masked diffusion loss according to policy probabilities, and results in a policy that prefers positions where the denoiser is more likely to be correct. We study this loss in two settings: (i) training solely the policy while using a frozen pre-trained denoiser, and (ii) training the policy and denoiser jointly with the weighted loss to allow for mutual adaptation. translated_title: 掩码扩散模型的自适应顺序策略
translated_abstract: 掩码扩散模型在捕捉文本和蛋白质等领域中离散序列的数据分布方面取得了巨大成功。这些模型通过从完全掩码的序列开始，迭代地对标记进行解掩码（unmasking）来生成数据，而解掩码的顺序通常采用随机选择或基于去噪器概率的启发式方法。在这项工作中，我们提出了一种在扩散模型之上使用额外的轻量级策略网络来学习解掩码顺序的方案。我们提出的损失函数根据策略概率对掩码扩散损失中的各项进行重新加权，从而使策略倾向于选择去噪器更可能正确预测的位置。我们在两种设置下研究了这一损失：（i）仅训练策略，同时使用冻结的预训练去噪器；（ii）使用加权损失联合训练策略和去噪器，以实现二者的相互适应。我们证明了我们的方法优于常见的基线方法。
tldr: 提出在掩码扩散模型之上增加一个轻量级策略网络，通过重加权的扩散损失学习最优的解掩码顺序，使策略优先选择去噪器更可能正确的位置，在仅训练策略和联合训练两种设置下均优于随机或启发式顺序。
en_tdlr: Proposes a lightweight policy network on top of masked diffusion models that learns the unmasking order via a reweighted loss favoring positions where the denoiser is most likely to be correct, outperforming random or heuristic ordering in both frozen-denoiser and joint-training settings.
